mapper.select: SELECT sub.ID id, sub.SUBJECT_NAME subjectName, sub.SUBJECT_URL subjectUrl,sub.PUBLISH_FLAG publishFlag, sub.CREATE_TIME createTime, sub.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, sub.SUBJECT_ORDER subjectOrder FROM APP_SUBJECT sub WHERE sub.CATALOG_CODE = '1' AND sub.DEL_FLAG = '1' ORDER BY sub.PUBLISH_FLAG DESC,sub.SUBJECT_ORDER ASC,sub.CREATE_TIME DESC
